# Neelam Dhiman

> Neelam Dhiman is a web developer from Kaithal, Haryana, India. Neelam builds websites, games and automation tools, and helps small businesses, schools and creators grow online with SEO, social media and video content.

## About
- Based in Kaithal, Haryana. Works with clients across Haryana, including Kurukshetra, Karnal, Hisar, Panipat, Sonipat, Ambala, Rohtak, Faridabad and Gurugram.
- Bachelor of Arts student at Kurukshetra University. Completed the O Level course from NIELIT and is now doing Digital Marketing with AI at NIELIT.
- Works with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and is learning Python and IoT.

## Services
- Website & App Building
- YouTube SEO & Digital Marketing
- Social Media Management
- Video Editing & Content Creation
- AI Tools & Vibe Coding
- Python Automation & Teamwork
